page.layout: One block of verse in a single column; page number at top right; marginal marks at the right edge of some lines (small notes/ticks, no printed note text).

p.i: Fusum per umbras sub patula ilice
Per saxa, ripas aut quatit herbidas.
Mox intrat hortum, quosque suo rigat
Dehinc poscit agros adque suum redit

page.notes: Marginal tick marks and small specks at line ends are not text. Some words are doubtful (e.g. "fusurris", "quosque", "Auctosque", "Lecto iacentem"); the verse is copied as printed where legible. The first line of the printed page begins with a catchword-like final word "Sed" at the foot, transcribed as catchword.
